findings.claim: The conductor caps override has no admissible `caps.timeout_source` token. Declared (new): "The following overrides completely define the non-worker variant" (:765) and "caps / overrides | existing supervision transport from admitted conductor configuration, with source; no worker job/default-role lookup" (:778). Declared (pre-existing, retained): "`caps.timeout` (seconds) resolves in one order: `DISPATCH_TIMEOUT` ... else the job's own `caps.timeout` in `jobs.json`, else 900 — and `caps.timeout_source` names the layer that answered: `DISPATCH_TIMEOUT`, `job`, or `default`" (:718-721). Practiced: launch.py:1003-1006 writes both keys unconditionally on every attempt, choosing among exactly those three tokens from `job_caps`. A conductor has null job, so the `job` layer is forbidden, and "admitted conductor configuration" is not one of the three tokens; an implementer must either label conductor-configured caps `default` (naming a layer that did not answer) or emit a token outside the closed enumeration. The supplied fixture takes a third route and omits both keys: both synthetic conductor records carry `caps` as `{cap-out, source}` only, including the success record that registers attempt 1. This is the same namespace-incompatibility shape as the closed p2, narrowed to one field; it does not block record construction.

The F5 remedy replaces one unresolvable citation with two others. Declared (new): "The bounded unit1a correction preserves combined commit `f15ca22c7d0cedb14f8d299fd61d7135f04ea9bc`, invalid worker record `20260906T111519Z-code-codex-dce07d` and the historical absence checker. The conductor separately retains the original `01-interface-fix.patch` with `01-COMMIT_MSG` and `02-unit1a.patch` with `02-COMMIT_MSG` as durable coordination inputs." Practiced: `git cat-file -t` resolves f15ca22, but `grep -rn 20260906T111519Z-code-codex-dce07d .` returns exactly one hit — this sentence itself; no such record is committed under .dev/records/dispatches/ (252 records, 111519Z absent), while invalid-envelope records are otherwise committed normally (20260903T224231Z-review-codex-312a39.json:135). The four retained artifacts are named by filename with no repository, commit, record id or digest, and the archive commit c35ed64 named in the supplied README is not an object here (`git cat-file -t c35ed64`: fatal, Not a valid object name). The producer declared the absence honestly (fix record note, "which were not supplied here"), and the ruling assigns retention to the conductor, so the remedy is a locator or the four SHA-256 digests the supplied archive README already carries — not a re-commit.
